title: Pan-Seared Os Rolls
description: Crispy and savory os rolls pan-seared to perfection. Served with a sweet and sour dipping sauce. A delicious and easy-to-make Chinese-inspired dish.
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the os rolls and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add the spring rolls and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, hoisin sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar.
Pour the sauce over the os rolls and spring rolls, and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve hot with additional dipping sauce, if desired.
